name: yc
description: Command line interface for Yandex Cloud

options.name: --debug-grpc
options.description: Debug gRPC logging. Very verbose, used for debugging connection problems

options.name: --no-user-output
options.description: Disable printing user intended output to stderr

options.name: --retry
options.description: Set the number of gRPC retry attempts (0 disables, negative means infinite)

options.name: --cloud-id
options.description: Set the ID of the cloud to use

options.name: --folder-id
options.description: Set the ID of the folder to use

options.name: --folder-name
options.description: Set the name of the folder to use (will be resolved to id)

options.name: --token
options.description: Set the OAuth token to use

options.name: --impersonate-service-account-id
options.description: Set the ID of the service account to impersonate

options.name: --jq
options.description: Query to select values from the response using jq syntax
